title: Verify: GitOps layout validator and round seed YAML unit tests
summary: Add Go tests for ValidateLayout and ROUND-0000001 YAML seed fields using MapFS fixtures.
description:
Context: ACT-GITOPS added ValidateLayout and seed YAML without tests.
Desired behavior: Unit-test layout success/failure with MapFS; unit-test round seed decoding from a fixture that mirrors round.yaml contract.
Expected result: Filtered go test for layout/round seed passes without reading the real repository disk.
Why: Proves REQ-GITOPS path and ROUND-0000001 seed ACs with mocked FS.
acceptance_criteria: Given MapFS containing all RequiredPaths, when ValidateLayout runs, then error is nil.
Given MapFS missing round.yaml, when ValidateLayout runs, then error message contains missing required path and round.yaml.
Given fixture YAML mirroring round.yaml contract, when decoded into a RoundSeed struct in the test file, then id/number/status/duration/max/base_release match OPEN seed values.

preserve: ValidateLayout and seed file contracts from ACT-GITOPS

technical_constraints: Use testing/fstest.MapFS; fixture YAML must mirror round.yaml
No real filesystem dependency on repo checkout for assertions
definition_of_done: layout_test.go covers success, missing path, and round seed field assertions

steps.action: Create TestValidateLayout_OK with MapFS entries for each RequiredPaths key (empty file bodies ok); assert ValidateLayout returns nil. Create TestValidateLayout_MissingRound that omits round.yaml; assert error string contains missing required path and round.yaml. Package main.
steps.expected: ValidateLayout success and missing-path unit tests pass.

steps.action: In the same test file, add TestRoundSeedFixture_Fields that yaml-decodes a ROUND_YAML fixture mirroring round.yaml contract into a local struct with fields Id, Number, Status, DurationHours, MaxContributionsPerPlayer, BaseRelease and asserts ROUND-0000001 / 1 / OPEN / 24 / 5 / 1.0.0. Import gopkg.in/yaml.v3 in the test.
steps.expected: ROUND-0000001 seed field unit test passes against the round.yaml contract fixture.
